label: Status
description: The workflow state of a record, such as New, In progress, or Resolved. A status field is bound to the entity's workflow: its choice list mirrors the workflow states and it changes only when a workflow transition fires. It renders as a badge with the state's tone.
usage: Use exactly one status field per entity that has a workflow, and name it status.
Change states with transitions (action.transition_buttons), never by placing an editable status field.
Give every option a tone so the badge is meaningful at a glance.
constraints: choiceList is required; its option IDs must equal the workflow's state IDs.
The field must be the stateField of the entity's workflow; an entity has at most one status field.
Never writable through the record API, inline edit, imports, rule set_value, or AI edits; only workflow transitions change it.
No default: new records start in the workflow's initialState.

valueSchema.description: Option ID equal to a workflow state ID.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Not editable. Use transition buttons or the command palette to change the state.
accessibility.notes: Rendered as a text badge; the state label is the text and the tone is decorative, so meaning never depends on color.

responsive: Badge keeps its size at all widths.

examples.description: Ticket status bound to the ticket lifecycle
